info.name: Hermetical — Phase 2
info.description:
Full API test suite for Hermetical Phase 2 (Automation & Protection).

Run via Collection Runner in sequence. The Simulate Disruption request triggers the complete DTPM pipeline: disruption event → claim auto-generation → fraud check → Razorpay mock payout → LLM Hinglish explanation.

Environment variables are auto-captured from responses — import Hermetical.postman_environment.json and select it before running.
